_comment: Data-driven bottom panel. `launchers` are freedesktop desktop-ids (resolved as applications:<id>.desktop) pinned in the icon-tasks widget, in order. `pager_names` name the 4 virtual desktops. The system-monitor widget sensor IDs live in bottom-panel.nix (they are fixed KSystemStats identifiers, not project data). PSI (pressure) is intentionally absent — KSystemStats exposes no /proc/pressure sensor; PSI lives in Cloud-Terminal → System Performance. height=64 (was 46, 2026-07-04): KDE bug 489307 — org.kde.plasma.systemmonitor's CompactRepresentation.qml derives its rendered size entirely from the sensor face's own Layout.preferredWidth/Height (read from CompactRepresentation.qml, org.kde.ksysguard.faces), which for chart-style faces (barchart/linechart) scales with panel height on a Horizontal panel; at 46px that computed size rounded to near-zero so those widgets occupied no visible space (textonly faces like CPU% still rendered, since their size floor is looser). Confirmed live via plasma scripting (panels()[0].height=64) before committing. height=60 (2026-08-07): that 64 was a workaround for a widget that is gone — com.diegonmarcos.watchdog draws its own text and pies and does not derive its size from a ksysguard sensor face, so the 489307 floor no longer applies and the panel is sized for how it looks.
